content: Claude custom connectors (claude.com/docs/connectors/building, fetched 2026-11-27): use Streamable HTTP (legacy HTTP+SSE still accepted, being deprecated); HTTPS on port 443 only, reachable from Anthropic egress 160.79.104.0/21. Auth types: oauth_dcr and oauth_cimd supported by default, none supported, static_headers beta. Claude uses CIMD only if AS metadata advertises client_id_metadata_document_supported=true AND none in token_endpoint_auth_methods_supported, else falls back to DCR. Redirect URI for hosted surfaces: https://claude.ai/api/mcp/auth_callback; Claude Code uses loopback http://localhost|127.0.0.1/callback on any port (port-agnostic match required). 401 with WWW-Authenticate resource_metadata pointer is required; only first authorization_servers entry used; S256 PKCE always; token endpoint must accept form-urlencoded; rotate refresh tokens for public clients; OAuth endpoints must answer in 10s (refresh 30s). Limits: tool result ~150,000 chars and 240s per tool call on claude.ai/Desktop; 25,000 tokens in Claude Code. Not supported: resource subscriptions, sampling. Install link: https://claude.ai/customize/connectors?modal=add-custom-connector&connectorName=NAME&connectorUrl=ENCODED_URL (prefills dialog only). File transfers are directory-listing only (beta), need MCP 2026-07-28 and @modelcontextprotocol/server 2.4.0.
